decisions: No host front-end: this host does not require one.
Redact credentials from the archived build prompt.
Builder token is fine-grained; use verified endpoint permissions rather than assuming classic scopes.
Cloudflare credential is account-scoped: verify via /accounts/{id}/tokens/verify; user-token endpoint is not applicable. Both account token and Pages API accepted it.
tmux pipe-pane supplies raw PTY output independently of viewers.
Actions runner HOME is isolated under runner.temp to preserve the required ~/work path.
Default: qwen3:14b; context 16384; thinking off; max 60 steps; bounded extractive summaries.
Runtime PATs must be classic repo+workflow; builder fine-grained permissions were verified against actual APIs.
Git Data API performs conflict-checked, non-force template updates; workspace is never touched.
Release is a prerelease pending the first real Colab/T4 confirmation.
